verdict: Teradyne's revenue jumped 70% to $1.31B as AI chip-testing demand surged — semiconductor test alone brought in $1.07B, and profit nearly tripled to $342M.

kpis.label: Operating cash flow
kpis.note: $86M spent on property & equipment in the quarter

segments.name: Semiconductor Test
segments.note: Machines that test computer chips — record Memory and Integrated Systems Test sales driven by AI chips and data centers.

segments.name: Product Test
segments.note: Testing finished products and systems, including hard-disk drives, wireless and defense work — helped by AI demand.

segments.name: Robotics
segments.note: Warehouse and factory robots (MiR and Universal Robots) — its best third quarter ever, and the unit turned profitable.

opex.name: Selling & administrative
opex.note: Selling the testers and robots and running the company — includes $3.7M of costs for a new ERP (business software) system.

opex.name: Engineering & development
opex.note: Designing the next generation of test machines and robots.

opex.name: Acquired intangible amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of patents and technology bought in past acquisitions over their useful lives.

otherDetail: Interest and other income of $2M, net. Below that line, $3M of equity earnings from an affiliate, minus $5M of profit belonging to noncontrolling interests, roughly cancel out — so the chart shows almost no other-income step.
oneTimers: Non-GAAP EPS was $2.29 vs GAAP $2.17 — the gap is $5M of acquired-intangible amortization, $2M of restructuring and other charges, and their tax effects.
Cost of revenue included a $10.7M net charge for excess and obsolete inventory — a $10.9M provision, partly offset by selling stock that had previously been written down.
footerNote: Figures are rounded to the nearest $M from a statement reported in $ thousands (revenue was $1,305,950 thousand). Net income is the amount attributable to Teradyne ($342M); consolidated net income was $348M before $5M belonging to noncontrolling interests.

takeaways.title: AI testing is the whole story
takeaways.text: Semiconductor Test revenue rose 77% to $1,072M — 82 cents of every revenue dollar — on record memory and integrated-systems test sales tied to AI chips.

takeaways.title: Profit nearly tripled
takeaways.text: Net income attributable to Teradyne was $342M ($2.17 per share) vs $120M ($0.75) a year ago, as the extra sales dropped through at a 31% operating margin.

takeaways.title: Robotics turned the corner
takeaways.text: Robotics posted its highest third-quarter revenue yet, $96M, up 28%, and reached profitability after last year's restructuring cut about 150 jobs.
